language_task: Pack the coffee pods onto the wooden tray.
outcome_evidence: The robot clears the banana from the tray (frames 87–200, overhead_cam and wrist_cam), then transfers three coffee pods onto it, visible after releases at frames 375, 625 and 765. The fourth acquisition fails: the pod remains on the table while the gripper withdraws empty (frames 839–855, both cameras). The robot subsequently moves over the tray and opens its empty gripper (frames 902–908, wrist_cam). At frame 1019, overhead_cam still shows three pods on the tray and one on the table; this is a visibly incomplete task following a failed attempt, not merely unconfirmed completion.

failure_annotations.explanation: During closure, the fourth pod shifts out of the grasp (frames 836–839, wrist_cam). The gripper then lifts and moves away empty while the pod remains on the tabletop (frames 840–855, overhead_cam and wrist_cam). It continues to the tray and opens without delivering a pod (frames 902–908, wrist_cam), so this acquisition-and-transfer attempt does not advance packing.
failure_annotations.recovery: Return to the remaining pod, realign the open fingers around its body, and verify a secure lift before transporting and releasing it onto the tray; no human intervention is needed on the visible evidence.
failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The pod remains on the usable tabletop; no damage, spill or meaningful damage risk is visible.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: The remaining pod is accessible for another grasp, and the three packed pods can stay on the tray; no environmental reset or human assistance is required.
